name: 岁知社 IPTrust
purpose: Retrieve current IP names, brand guidelines, exact color tokens, canonical logos, public assets, provenance and version history.

authentication.public: No API key is required for public brand records, public assets, search and MCP reads.
authentication.private: Use an authorized Bearer API key for private assets, protected notes and write operations.

recommendedWorkflow: Resolve an IP slug with the brand index, directory or MCP list_ips.
Read the current IP through MCP get_brand/get_guideline or GET /api/brands/{slug}.json.
Use mainName in mainLanguage. Treat alternate names as secondary labels.
Use theme values exactly and use logoUrl as the canonical logo.
Use images[] or MCP list_assets for format, size, dimensions, access and copyable asset URLs.
Check sources[] and history before citing or applying a standard.

fieldGuide.mainName: Primary public IP name selected by mainLanguage.
fieldGuide.mainLanguage: The language that controls the primary displayed name.
fieldGuide.theme: Exact callable brand color tokens and visual keywords.
fieldGuide.images: Public image assets with format, byte size, dimensions, SHA-256 and URL.
fieldGuide.guides: Rendered and source brand guideline content.
fieldGuide.fonts: Open-source commercial-use font references with official provenance, licenses, CSS stacks and R2-hosted web specimens.
